memories.content: Cameron is Prime Minister and has called the EU referendum for 23 June 2016. He is leading the Remain campaign. He has not yet decided whether to appear in any televised set-piece events, but is aware of the campaign schedule and media requests.

The EU referendum is scheduled for 23 June 2016. Televised set-piece events (such as debates or major interviews) are being organized by broadcasters. The campaign period is ongoing, and the public expects to see leading figures from both sides in such events.
